prose: Reuters reports that Anthropic committed to spending $11.6B over seven years on Akamai cloud services and secured an option to take a stake of up to 5% in the company; Akamai shares jumped more than 17% on the news. The article is behind bot protection, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
